Component gallery

Component gallery

A live, visual index of every shadshiny component, grouped by tier. Start here to browse the library.

Gallery: display & typography

Every Tier 1 display component — buttons, badges, avatars, cards, alerts, tables, progress, and the typography set — rendered live with its source.

Gallery: form inputs

Tier 2 bound inputs — text, select, combobox, checkbox, switch, radio, toggle, slider, OTP and date pickers — rendered live with their source.

Gallery: overlays & menus

Tier 3 overlays — dialog, sheet, drawer, popover, tooltip, hover-card, dropdown, context-menu, menubar and the command palette — live and clickable.

Gallery: navigation & structure

Tier 3 layout — tabs, accordion, collapsible, pagination, carousel, scroll-area, resizable panels, the layout primitives and the sidebar family — rendered live.

Gallery: data, dashboards & flow

The V2 kit — data table, value boxes, sparklines, donuts, chart containers, timelines, stepper, tree, rating, number input and dropzone — rendered live with their source.

Gallery: chat & AI kit

The streaming-transcript primitives — bubbles, messages, attachments, markers and the stick-to-bottom scroller — rendered live with their source.

Icons

The full shadshiny icon set, rendered live, and how to use icon names across buttons, badges, menus and items.
